accessFindings.previousAttempt: Initial-pass requests to `https://www.map.gov.zm/...` failed: exact metadata URL is preserved under priorRequests (HTTP 000); the bounded query to the www host also timed out. These are distinct from the successful metadata and query requests below, which used `https://map.gov.zm` without www.
accessFindings.newFinding: The canonical no-www host `map.gov.zm` responds with the same service and returns a bounded Mansa polygon. No proxy, auth bypass, or certificate verification override was used.
accessFindings.headerProfile: Chrome desktop User-Agent; Accept application/json/geo+json; Accept-Language en-ZM; Referer https://map.gov.zm/; requests.Session cookie jar.
accessFindings.adapterCompatibility: The published REST objectIdFieldName and response property names are dotted (`SDE.Lots.OBJECTID`, `SDE.Lots.UPID`). Unqualified outFields=UPID fails; qualified outFields and where expressions work. The layer advertises supportsPagination=false; resultOffset/resultRecordCount requests return `Pagination is not supported.` Parent-led production adapter acceptance remains separate from the verified raw sample.

requests.assessment: Service layer metadata retrieved from the no-www canonical host.
Nine bounded cells each had count == complete object-ID manifest == full object-ID geometry fetch. See africa-ws-mansa-9grid.json.

All 86 distinct observed UPIDs exact-resolved in 9 unfiltered batches with complete counts, OID manifests and geometries; geometry hashes exactly match spatially observed geometry. See africa-ws-mansa-native-exact.json.

limitations: Only Mansa was verified. This does not establish all Mansa coverage, full Zambia coverage, or household-scale lots; no ownership fields were requested or retained.
